name: Hub
description: Rings whose bore opens as they get further out, so the middle of the sheet is solid and the edge is nearly all hole.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 5%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent @calc(0 + 78 * @sqrt(@abs(2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) * @abs(2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) + @abs(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y) * @abs(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y)))%, #000 0); mask: radial-gradient(circle closest-side at 50% 50%, transparent @calc(0 + 78 * @sqrt(@abs(2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) * @abs(2 * @x / @X - 1 - 1 / @X) + @abs(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y) * @abs(2 * @y / @Y - 1 - 1 / @Y)))%, #000 0); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
